title: A custom policy resolves to its declared parameters and permits no exploratory proposals
rationale: Exploratory permission is the one parameter a custom policy cannot reach: the v0.1 parameter set has no field granting it, so a custom policy is never exploratory however permissive its other three values are.

requirement.text: Exploratory proposals ... are permitted only under the explorer preset; the v0.1 parameter set has no field granting exploratory permission to a custom policy.
